top_signals.title: Korea-Hong Kong Correlation Shows Shorts Unwind: Equity Insight
top_signals.summary: Global funds entered short positions in Hong Kong tech stocks earlier this year to raise funds to invest in South Korea’s chip giants, but the latest correlation numbers show those trades look to be rapidly unwinding.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
